Character Bio

Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of Madoka's. She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others.

She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks Kyubey in the first episode, only to be stopped by Mami.

Sure it's nationally relevant and a showing of national patriotism... But you're a municipal/county/state entity. If you insist on putting another decal on your vehicles, I'd much rather you incorporate your city/county/state seal in some way instead of something national. With that in mind, maybe it also maybe ties into over-stepping, in a way? Like if a private security company started placing "To Protect and Serve" on their vehicles, I would also be bothered because it would seem inappropriate.

I also think the "we" in "In God We Trust" comes off as a bit more menacing on a squad car than it does on money. The opt-in nature of it adds to that; it's not as if there is non-God money and God money. We all use the same bills independent of our religious affiliations. In that sense, I would be more okay if there was a bill passed that placed this phrase on all law enforcement vehicles, rather than a select few doing it, as that would make it come off less personal.
